patent.ref: US Patent 259,054 granted to Henry W. Seely for an Electric Flatiron
patent.ref_zh: 西利获得电平熨斗美国专利259,054号

mass_production.ref: Earl Richardson introduced the lightweight Hotpoint iron with heated tip in Ontario, California
mass_production.ref_zh: 厄尔·理查森在加州推出前端集中发热的轻便 Hotpoint 电熨斗

popularization.ref: Eldec Co. introduced the first commercial electric steam iron, easing fabric care
popularization.ref_zh: Eldec 公司推出首款商用电蒸汽熨斗，蒸汽功能迅速普及于家用熨烫

summary_zh: 电熨斗通过电热元件加热底板并配合压力与蒸汽平整织物。1882年西利发明电平熨斗，告别了传统炭火加热；20世纪温控与蒸汽功能的加入使其成为衣物打理的必备品。
summary_en: The electric iron uses heated resistance elements to press clothes. Patented by Henry Seely in 1882, it replaced charcoal-heated irons and later integrated thermostats and steam for fabric care.
summary_ja: 電気アイロンは抵抗体の熱で衣服を押す。1882年に Henry Seely が特許を得て、炭火アイロンに取って代わり、後に温度調節とスチームを備えた。
